name: How Should We Pray
overview: Scripture teaches that prayer is a sincere communication with God, not a public display or repetitive chant, as Jesus warns against praying to be seen by others or using vain repetitions (Matthew 6:5,7). Instead, believers are instructed to approach God as their heavenly Father, honoring His name and praying in a manner that reflects reverence and truth (Matthew 6:9). Jesus models this intimate relationship through His own prayers and promises that prayer offered in His name aligns with God's will and brings glory to the Father (Luke 11:1; John 14:13). Ultimately, Jesus is the exclusive way to the Father, emphasizing that true prayer is grounded in faith in Him (John 14:6).
